name: ship-cycle-devkit
description: A gated, constitution-enforcing development lifecycle: requirements → design → review → test → implement → verify → PR, with risk-based model routing. Framework-agnostic; project specifics come from an overlay config.

interface.shortDescription: Gated dev lifecycle: design → review → test → implement → verify → PR.
interface.longDescription: A gated development lifecycle with independent review, execution-based verification and worktree isolation. PREFLIGHT classifies change size, nature and risk, routes each stage to a model and effort tier, then chains the stage skills through gates G1-G13. Framework-agnostic: repo specifics come from a project overlay config.
